messages:
Anna: heads-up — a small group of tenants saw delayed embeddings due to export-queue backpressure after an aggressive retry loop. Need a short customer note + offer for live troubleshooting. @Kevin can you confirm cause and whether we reprocessed?
Kevin: root cause: ingest workers retried immediately on 429s from export service; that retry spike filled the export queue and led to some writes being dropped. Mitigation: rate-limited retries, exponential backoff, and a temporary retry cache. Patch deployed 03:10 UTC; queues normalized.
Emily: thanks. Draft a customer-friendly blurb please, short and apologetic. Offer 30m office hours and a credit. 
Anna: first draft —

"Hi — we’re sorry for the interruption. A transient retry surge caused some embeddings to be delayed or lost for a subset of customers. We’ve fixed the retry behavior, reprocessed most affected data, and applied a one-week credit to impacted accounts. Reply to schedule a 30-minute troubleshooting session and we’ll prioritize your tenant." 

Jordan: please attach the affected tenant list to the support ticket and queue the CSV of affected document ids if reprocessing succeeded. I can send emails when copy final.
Kevin: reprocess status: ~62% auto-replayed, ~28% require manual replay (some blocked by schema drift), ~10% failed permanently and need customer follow-up. I’ll add a replay summary and per-tenant CSV to ticket #CS-12842.
ops-bot: public status entry created: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1717778000 — internal summary will follow.
Emily: please be explicit on credits: "a one-week service credit applied to your next invoice; contact your CSM for immediate needs." Also propose a triage: 30m office hours + follow-up notes.
Anna: agreed. Action items: 1) Jordan: send the customer note + tenant list, 2) Kevin: attach CSV + replay logs to CS-12842, 3) CS teams: schedule office hours, 4) Ops: publish public status after CS outreach. I’ll prepare a short exec note.
Kevin: added remediation item for infra: add CI synthetic test for export 429 behavior and include a guardrail for queue depth. 
ops-bot: billing queue updated with label incident-1717778000 for credits.
Emily: FYI to Renewals — flag any customers with high impact so we can offer tailored enablement and extra credit where needed.
Anna: thanks all — please paste any customer feedback here so we capture it for the post-incident follow-up. Closing the bridge after emails go out.
